settings.title: Google Search Console
settings.subtitle: Connect Search Console so RankMeFast can show real index status and rich-result verdicts in your audits.

connect.title: Connect Google Search Console
connect.description: Let RankMeFast read your index status and rich-results verdicts from Search Console. Requires a verified property.
connect.scopeNote: We request read-only access to your Search Console data.

connected.title: Connected
connected.subtitle: Choose which Search Console property RankMeFast reads from.
connected.propertyMissing: No verified properties found — we'll auto-detect a match on the next audit.

needsReconnect.title: Your Google connection needs to be reconnected
needsReconnect.body: Google requires re-consent — this happens if you revoked access or the connection sat unused for months. Your audits still run without it, but index-status data will be missing.

disconnect.confirmBody: This removes this site's Search Console and Analytics selections. Other sites and the shared Google sign-in stay connected.
disconnect.siteUnlinked: Google was unlinked from this site.

revoke.confirmBody_one: This revokes Google access and unlinks the {{count}} connected site. This cannot be limited to the current site.
revoke.confirmBody_zero: This revokes Google access and unlinks all {{count}} connected sites. This cannot be limited to the current site.
revoke.confirmBody_two: This revokes Google access and unlinks all {{count}} connected sites. This cannot be limited to the current site.
revoke.confirmBody_few: This revokes Google access and unlinks all {{count}} connected sites. This cannot be limited to the current site.
revoke.confirmBody_many: This revokes Google access and unlinks all {{count}} connected sites. This cannot be limited to the current site.
revoke.confirmBody_other: This revokes Google access and unlinks all {{count}} connected sites. This cannot be limited to the current site.
